gaps.sentence: She decided ___ the job offer in Berlin.
gaps.explanation: decide takes the to-infinitive: decided to accept.

gaps.sentence: We managed ___ everyone before the storm hit.
She made her son ___ his room before dinner.
gaps.explanation: make + object + bare infinitive: made him tidy (passive takes to: was made to tidy).

gaps.sentence: It's high time we ___ this attic.
gaps.explanation: it's (high) time + subject + past simple (unreal past): time we cleared.

gaps.sentence: He spent hours ___ to fix the printer.
I regret ___ so rude to her at the party.
gaps.explanation: regret + -ing = feel sorry about something you did.
pretend + to-infinitive; negative: not to hear.

gaps.sentence: I regret ___ you that the flight has been cancelled.
gaps.explanation: regret + to-infinitive (formal announcements); regret + -ing = be sorry about the past.
